title: A theme switch that sweeps up the page
blurb: A switch changes color-scheme on a card of native controls. The canvas keeps a picture of the old look, takes one of the new look, and shows the change as a dome of light that rises through the card. In 2D it's a clip and a glow. As a shader the text bends and splits into colours at the edge.
question: When an element changes theme, can a canvas hold its old picture and its new one and mix them, with the browser still drawing the native controls for each scheme?
result: Yes. A copy of the canvas taken before the class changes is the old look and the next paint is the new one. After that the sweep draws no element at all, in 2D or through a shader.
